s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent depressive disorder with new onset of abnormal sensations in the upper limbs
salient_findings: New onset of deep itching and creeping sensations in bilateral shoulders and arms
key_facts: 31-year history of recurrent depressive disorder
Depressed mood, anhedonia, nervousness, fatigue, decreased appetite, and poor sleep began 5 months after COVID-19
Two severe episodes responsive to escitalopram and duloxetine
Intolerance to venlafaxine, bupropion, and trazodone
Mother had mania
Denied iron deficiency anemia, hypothyroidism, or substance abuse
Physical and neurologic examinations were unremarkable
Routine laboratory tests were unremarkable
New symptoms of deep itching and creeping sensations in bilateral shoulders and arms
Symptoms worse at rest, partially relieved by movement, and predominantly occurring in the evening
Symptoms caused night-time sleep disturbance

shortlist.label: Restless legs syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: New onset of abnormal sensations in the upper limbs, worse at rest, partially relieved by movement, and predominantly occurring in the evening

shortlist.label: Akathisia
shortlist.why_kept: New symptoms of deep itching and creeping sensations in bilateral shoulders and arms, potentially related to medication side effects

shortlist.label: Small fiber neuropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Abnormal sensations in the upper limbs, which could be indicative of small fiber neuropathy

shortlist.label: Fibromyalgia
shortlist.why_kept: History of recurrent depressive disorder, fatigue, and widespread pain, which are common symptoms of fibromyalgia

shortlist.label: Notalgia paresthetica
shortlist.why_kept: Localized itching and creeping sensations in the upper limbs, consistent with notalgia paresthetica

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of deep itching and creeping sensations in bilateral shoulders and arms, worse at rest and partially relieved by movement, are consistent with akathisia, a known side effect of antidepressants such as escitalopram and duloxetine, which the patient was taking.

rejected.label: Restless legs syndrome
rejected.why: While similar, restless legs syndrome primarily affects the legs, not the arms and shoulders, and is not typically associated with deep itching sensations.

rejected.label: Small fiber neuropathy
rejected.why: This condition would likely have been detected on neurologic examination or routine laboratory tests, which were unremarkable.

rejected.label: Fibromyalgia
rejected.why: Fibromyalgia is characterized by widespread musculoskeletal pain, not specifically deep itching and creeping sensations in the arms and shoulders.

rejected.label: Notalgia paresthetica
rejected.why: This condition is characterized by localized itching and numbness in the upper back, not the bilateral shoulders and arms as described in the patient's symptoms.
